boundary: Same-owner workflow and mutation evidence only; no independent reproduction or protected-gate closure.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the SyntaxError at zero credit, correct only the missing parenthesis, and rerun the staged-index comparison against the already committed expected allowlist.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Compile or visually balance compact inline assertions before using their output as a staged-review witness.
closeout_methods.rollback: The failed read-only comparison changed no worktree, index, repository history, remote, sibling, external, or authority state.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the IndexError at zero credit, read the exact line count, and bound the next window by that verified count.

closeout_methods.rollback: The failed read-only window changed no repository, branch, remote, sibling, external, or authority state.
